payment.hint: You pay the vendor when the order is delivered. There is no online payment on TerraByte.

catalog.title: Marketplace
catalog.subtitle: Seeds, fertilisers and tools listed by approved vendors. Prices are set by the vendors.
catalog.vendorNote: You can browse the marketplace here. Only farmers can place orders.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search by product, brand or vendor
catalog.emptyBody: Products appear here as soon as approved vendors list them.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.oneOrderPerVendor: Items from different vendors become separate orders.
cart.estimateNote: This is an estimate from the listed prices. The final amount is calculated when you place the order.

checkout.title: Place order
checkout.subtitle: Check the quantity, delivery address and payment method.
checkout.addressHint: Village, taluka, district and a landmark help the vendor deliver.
checkout.successBody_one: Your order was sent to the vendor. You will be notified when its status changes.
checkout.successBody_other: {{count}} orders were sent, one to each vendor. You will be notified when their status changes.
checkout.serverTotals: Totals above are calculated by TerraByte from the vendors' current prices.

orders.title: My orders
orders.subtitle: Orders you placed on the marketplace and their status.
orders.empty: You have not placed any orders yet.
orders.emptyBody: Orders you place on the marketplace will appear here.

detail.title: Order #{{id}}
detail.addedToAccounts: This delivered order was added to your farm accounts as an expense.
detail.cancelBody: You can cancel until the vendor accepts the order. The vendor will be notified.

form.subtitle: Farmers see these details in the marketplace.
form.name: Product name

errors.nameRequired: Enter a product name (at least 2 characters).
errors.priceInvalid: Enter a price above ₹0 with at most 2 decimals.
errors.stockInvalid: Stock must be a whole number, 0 or more.

vendorProducts.title: My products
vendorProducts.subtitle: Products you list in the marketplace. Deactivated products are hidden from farmers.
vendorProducts.empty: You have not listed any products yet.
vendorProducts.emptyBody: Add your first product so farmers can order it.

vendorOrders.title: Orders
vendorOrders.subtitle: Orders from farmers. Accept, ship and mark them delivered.
vendorOrders.emptyBody: When a farmer orders your products, the order appears here and you get a notification.

confirmBody.accept: {{buyer}} will be notified that you accepted the order.
confirmBody.reject: The stock returns to your listing and {{buyer}} is notified.
confirmBody.ship: {{buyer}} will be notified that the order is on its way.
confirmBody.deliver: Only do this after the goods have been handed over and paid. {{buyer}} will be notified.

vendorOrders.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. no delivery to this village this week
